recommendation: Keep the commit. The core MeasureReport StructureDefinition already carried the WG-approved boolean type; this narrow source fix removes the remaining active metadata inconsistency for CQL modelinfo consumers without altering unrelated MeasureReport semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-46238 was an Applied/Persuasive CQI R6 change request to allow Boolean values on MeasureReport measureScore elements for attestation-style measures; the accepted resolution was to allow boolean as a possible type in the MeasureReport measureScore elements.
initial_application: Commit da71fb39ce81cab9f55b3210115d4e41ab6bf077 from PR #3314 added boolean to the two authoritative MeasureReport StructureDefinition score elements, MeasureReport.group.measureScore[x] and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.measureScore[x]. That application did not update the active FHIR model-definition Library metadata, which still listed the corresponding modelinfo properties as FHIR.Quantity only.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps both MeasureReport and Library active in the current build. The Library examples page links library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml as the FHIR model information file used by the CQL-to-ELM translator, and recent reconciliation work in this run has kept that content and the embedded Library attachment synchronized with resource model changes. Jira and community searches found no later core decision reversing the boolean score change; a broad Zulip hit discussed a separate DEQM/FHIRPath invariant issue after boolean attestation MeasureReports were in use.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so MeasureReport.Stratum.measureScore and MeasureReport.Group.measureScore use a ChoiceTypeSpecifier containing Quantity, dateTime, CodeableConcept, Period, Range, Duration, boolean, and Ratio. Refreshed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so the embedded base64 attachment decodes exactly to the updated raw modelinfo content.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: converted both MeasureReport measureScore modelinfo entries from FHIR.Quantity-only to the full StructureDefinition choice set including FHIR.boolean.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: refreshed the embedded model-definition attachment to match the updated raw modelinfo content.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the broad Zulip DEQM invariant thread surfaced by MeasureReport measureScore boolean searches; it concerns separate IG/FHIRPath constraint behavior rather than the core MeasureReport model metadata fixed here.
